decision: P8 final closure. Fresh counterbalanced two-run C1-C8 matrix on one physical host: hipEngine exact-peer closure achieved (binding two-order D24 candidate mean 95.240 tok/s above both the published 94.735 (+0.53%) and fresh 92.345 (+3.13%) current-llama.cpp rows); strongest-peer closure NOT achieved (95.240 below published Laurent 101.072 by 5.77% and below fresh Laurent 95.830 by 0.62%). The residual is quantified by the P6 reprofile: 24.850 ms/cycle non-device wall that the launch-only ceiling cannot repair. Campaign closes with the quantified strongest-peer blocker and exact reopen conditions; C1-C7 non-regression passes and the automatic capacity-8 K0 product policy is preserved.
